item.title: Police service dog Mack leads pursuit, locates suspects after industrial break-in
item.description: Police service dog Mack was an extra good boy on Saturday after he successfully tracked two suspects who were eventually charged with stripping copper wiring from industrial buildings in Brantford. item.title: Downtown Dig in Paris gets ready to ramp up
item.description: Spring, also known as the start of construction season, will mark the return of the Downtown Dig in Paris. Dubbed a “once-in-a-lifetime infrastructure project,” that happens every 75 to 100 years, the work will soon pick up where it left off last fall. item.title: Model railroading offers train lovers 'an escape from the world'
item.description: When Daryl Dankwardt was a little boy, he’d spend a week of his summer vacations in his grandpa’s basement watching him build and operate his miniature railway system.
